start: Body, Progress photos, a member with no photos

user_sees: Title 'Progress photos', subtitle 'Private. They stay on this phone.'
'No photos yet' and 'Add a photo'
must_not: A blank page

steps.action: Tap 'Add a photo', then 'Take a photo'
user_sees: Sheet 'Add a progress photo' 'Same spot, same light, every few weeks.' with 'Take a photo' and 'Choose from gallery'
The camera, then the new photo in the grid dated today
must_not: The photo added twice
The photo sent anywhere

user_sees: The photo full size, zoomable, with 'Save to phone gallery', 'Change date', 'Delete photo'
must_not: A different photo opens

start: Progress photos, a gallery picture with no date of its own

user_sees: Sheet 'When was this photo taken?' 'It came without a date of its own, so it shows today until you pick one.'
must_not: The photo silently dated today with no question

user_sees: The photo in the grid on that day
must_not: The day lost after the app restarts

start: Progress photos with two or more photos

steps.action: Tap 'Compare two photos', tap one then another
user_sees: 'Tap the first photo', 'Now tap the second photo', then page 'Compare' with how far apart they are
must_not: The same photo on both sides

user_sees: One picture of the first photo and the latest side by side, either one changeable, then the share list
must_not: A picture shared with no tap on share
The member's body weight on the share picture

steps.action: Tap 'Take a photo' and refuse the camera
user_sees: 'Camera not allowed. Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.'
Button 'Allow the camera in Settings'
must_not: A crash
A prompt on every tap

steps.action: Open a compare link where one photo was deleted
user_sees: 'Photos not found' 'One of these photos was deleted. Go back and pick two again.'
must_not: A broken picture

steps.action: 'Save to phone gallery' on a phone with no share list
user_sees: 'This phone has no share list, so the photo couldn’t be handed over.'
must_not: Nothing said

steps.action: Tap 'Change date' and pick another day
user_sees: The photo moves to that day in the grid
must_not: The photo shown on both days

user_sees: Ask 'Delete this photo?' 'From <date>. It is removed from the app for good.' with 'Delete'
must_not: Deleted without asking

user_sees: The photo gone from the grid, from Body, and its backup copy deleted
must_not: The backup copy left behind
The date row left in the cloud copy

start: Settings, 'Include photos in my backup' card, then Progress photos

steps.action: Turn 'Include photos in my backup' on
user_sees: 'Copying your newest photos…', then 'Android’s backup holds 25 MB for the whole app, so older photos may not fit. Turning this off deletes the copies.'
must_not: Full-size photos copied

user_sees: Subtitle 'Private. Your newest are in your phone’s backup too.'
must_not: The subtitle still saying 'They stay on this phone.'

user_sees: 'Off: photos stay on this phone only. To keep one anywhere else, open it and tap “Save to phone gallery”.'
The copies deleted
must_not: A copy still in the backup folder after off

start: Member with 'Include photos in my backup' on

steps.action: Read the privacy notice, then the photo backup card
user_sees: Privacy notice: 'Your progress photos never leave your phone, so we never get them.'
Card: 'Your newest progress photos go into Android’s backup to your Google account, as far as room allows.'
must_not: The notice saying photos never leave the phone while the app copies them to the member's Google backup

user_sees: Words that match the backup setting
must_not: 'It stays on your phone.' while the backup is on
